name: Albaida del Aljarafe (Spain)
description: White field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Albaida del Aljarafe (a tower on blue and an olive tree on blue, parted by a white pile).
history: Municipal flag of Albaida del Aljarafe; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Albaida del Aljarafe arms — tower and olive tree on blue, parted by a white pile
